name.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Vancouver Airport

description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Vancouver Airport is a branded chain hotel in Richmond, BC, located near Vancouver International Airport on Sexsmith Road. It is operated by Wyndham Hotels and Resorts and was verified as an active property as recently as November 2025. Cyclists transiting the Greater Vancouver area may find it a convenient stopover, though no cycling-specific services could be confirmed from available content.

OSM confirms the property is an active hotel (check_date 2025-11-29, looks_closed=false) with WLAN internet access and wheelchair access, but per the rules, OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration. Neither required criterion has any supporting evidence from the available content.
